info.description: A turning ring of past editions. The one in the middle swells and names itself, and the ring never runs out.

__.note: Admin metadata for this schema. Strapi ignores this key; src/this/admin-metadata reads it and writes it into the content manager's stored configuration on every boot.

edit.label: Slides
edit.description: One past edition each, in the order they are shown. The label is the name written under the middle slide, so give every one of them a label. Wide pictures work best.
